items.label: diagnosis
items.evidence: `parse_pdf` is getting its hex code interpreted, breaking our cache key across Python invocations
items.rationale: It names the root cause: str(parse_pdf) includes a memory address, which changes the index-name hash. The reference fix replaces that string in settings.py. It does not describe the fix itself.
